program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-a9771d5d.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    patterns = []
    source_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            if c - start >= 2:
                seq = row[start:c]
                patterns.append(seq)
                source_cells.update((r, j) for j in range(start, c))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if not value or (r, c) in source_cells:
                continue
            for seq in patterns:
                if value in seq:
                    start = c - seq.index(value)
                    for i, color in enumerate(seq):
                        x = start + i
                        if 0 <= x < w:
                            out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
